Name: array
Summary: An array contains a sequence of values.

Literal.Syntax: Values enclosed in braces and separated by commas

Name: boolean
Summary: A boolean value is either true or false.

Name: date
Summary: A calendar date without a time component.

Name: decimal
Summary: A decimal is a numeric value written with a decimal separator.

Literal.Syntax: Digits with a . decimal separator, optionally preceded by a sign

Name: duration
Summary: An elapsed duration expressed using ISO 8601 notation.

Name: integer
Summary: An integer is a numeric value written without a decimal separator.

Literal.Syntax: Digits, optionally preceded by a sign

Name: null
Summary: Null represents the absence of a value.

Name: numeric
Summary: The common type family for integer and decimal values.

Name: record
Summary: Represents a value containing an ordered collection of named fields.

Name: scalar
Summary: The common type family for non-structured values.

Name: structured
Summary: The common type family for values containing other values.

Name: temporal
Summary: The common type family for date and time values.

Name: text
Summary: A text value represents a sequence of characters.

Literal.Syntax: A value enclosed in double quotes

Name: time
Summary: A time of day without a date component.

Name: tuple
Summary: Represents an immutable, ordered collection of heterogeneous values.

Literal.Syntax: T followed by parenthesized comma-separated values

Name: weekday
Summary: Represents a day of the week.

Name: year-month
Summary: Represents a calendar year and month.
